Harness/hook code in Phase 2 and the conversion in Phase 4 are covered by the acceptance corpus (DISC-T001) and full regression (DISC-T005). Matches runtime-refresh.md's strategy.

materialized_risks.detail: Real local transcripts yield ~27 deferral-shaped candidates, most of which are FALSE positives (this session's own DISPATCHED banners and meta-discussion). autonomy-hedge has 2 candidates, both likely FPs. The TRD 3.1 violation floors total 25 real violations and are not satisfiable from real data.
materialized_risks.resolution: RESOLVED — TRD 3.1 amended 2026-08-13: floors track real supply (deferral-explicit 10->8, novel-phrasing 5->6, no-result 5->7, incidental 5->8), plus 3 caveats and 3.1.1 payload context.

materialized_risks.detail: A prompt-type hook that always blocks loops: 4 cycles on Stop, 8 on SubagentStop, terminated only by the evaluated model's own judgment. No structural platform cap observed. TRD 6.1 A6 requires a demonstrated bound.
materialized_risks.resolution: RESOLVED — bounded two ways: undocumented platform cap CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP (default 8, verified in binary + live at cap=2), and stop_hook_active self-check giving exactly 1 extra turn. A6 satisfied. Loop guard is a prompt line, not infrastructure.

materialized_risks.detail: Synthetic cases were written from situations, and the generating agent did not read async-claim-detector.js or subagent-discipline.js. But async-discipline.md prose is force-loaded via CLAUDE.md every session, so zero exposure cannot be claimed.
materialized_risks.resolution: Recorded as TRD 3.1 caveat B: synthetic-class scores are indicative, not decisive.

materialized_risks.detail: TRD claimed the motivating 240k-token failure was vocabulary-free, justifying a no-result-returned class as 'the capability that justifies switching'. The actual incident text had deferral vocabulary. Data: 1 such case in 1,274 confirmed end_turn finals; 3 mining strategies found 0 more.
materialized_risks.resolution: CORRECTED — 2.3 premise withdrawn, A4 downgraded from gate to observation, floor 7->1, caveat D added. Switch now rests on the structural recall argument + 4 confirmed real misses.

materialized_risks.risk: Process — git add -A swept in-flight subagent work into unrelated commits
materialized_risks.detail: Commit a760070 was a TRD correction but carries ~1,300 lines of DISC-B004/B005 work (judge prompts, judge detector, generator hookType support, scaffold changes) because the orchestrator used `git add -A` on a worktree shared with running subagents. Files are complete, not half-written, so nothing is broken — but the commit message misrepresents its contents.
materialized_risks.resolution: Not rewriting history while agents are actively writing to the tree. Switching to targeted `git add <paths>`; B004/B005 completion commits will note that part of their work landed early in a760070.

materialized_risks.risk: Orchestrator emitted a DISPATCHED banner without dispatching
materialized_risks.detail: Turn ended claiming disc-b004 and disc-p002 were taking the next round (JSON per-case fix, prompt iteration, T002, T003). No SendMessage/Agent call was made. Work sat idle until the user asked for status. Also over-reported completion as 13/21 by incrementing a hand-maintained counter instead of deriving it from task statuses; true count was 10.
materialized_risks.resolution: completed_tasks now derived, not incremented. Stale in_progress reset. Noted: the async-discipline guard inspects claim TEXT, and a DISPATCHED banner is not a claim it matches — same blind spot class as the silent-non-delivery gap recorded in 0dd80d0.

materialized_risks.risk: A5 latency threshold not met on p50; measurement method inadequate at p95
materialized_risks.detail: 100 interleaved samples. Baseline p50 4522ms / p95 7551ms. Full prompt p50 7270 / p95 8910 -> added p50 +2748ms, differenced p95 +1359ms. Minimal prompt added p50 +1981ms. Model pinning gave NO benefit (p50 7437, slightly worse than default). Differencing percentiles is not the p95 of the added latency, and baseline variance (~3000ms spread) exceeds the 2000ms effect being measured, so the p95 figure cannot be trusted either way.
materialized_risks.resolution: pending orchestrator decision: amend A5 with a defensible metric, or trim the ~8KB prompt (worth ~770ms p50).

materialized_risks.risk: Judge is non-deterministic — acceptance criteria assume it is not
materialized_risks.detail: incidental-vocabulary: 0 FP in the scoped run, 1 FP in the full run, same 10 cases and same prompt. A zero-tolerance criterion (A2) cannot be established by a single run.
materialized_risks.resolution: pending: restate A2/A3 over a distribution (zero FPs in k consecutive runs) rather than as a single-run outcome.

materialized_risks.risk: TRD contained two mutually exclusive requirements (D5 rollback vs B009 deletion)
materialized_risks.detail: The lever regenerates prompt entries as command-type pointing at the .js hooks; B009 deletes those hooks detection logic. Running B009 would make the lever a silent no-op presenting as a safety mechanism.
materialized_risks.resolution: B009 deferred with an explicit trigger; B009 and D5 to be deleted together. T005 re-pointed to depend on B008 alone.

materialized_risks.risk: Conversion regression — dispatch ledger loses its compensating blocked row
materialized_risks.detail: subagent-discipline.js is now prompt-type so its JS never runs, and recordBlockInLedger with it. On a judge-blocked SubagentStop the ledger records stop with no blocked row, reporting a still-running agent as finished. Hooks run concurrently so dispatch-ledger.js cannot observe the judge verdict.
materialized_risks.resolution: Documented in async-discipline.md. Transient only — converges on the next stop, so the window is one corrective turn. Follow-up, not a blocker.
